questions.prompt: Which sentence tells about a red barn in At the Farm?
Which sentence tells about a chick in At the Farm?
What is the big idea of At the Farm?
choices: Many animals and plants live on a farm.
Only a red barn stands tall.
questions.answer: Many animals and plants live on a farm.
questions.rationale: A red barn stands tall. A chick says peep. There is much to see. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Many animals and plants live on a farm.

Page 1 gives the fact without "only". The other pages give different facts, so this choice is too small to be the whole book's big idea.
Page 3 gives the fact without "only". The other pages give different facts, so this choice is too small to be the whole book's big idea.
